title: Egg, Avocado & Tomato English Muffin Sandwich with Chili-Garlic Aioli

steps.text: Place yogurt, mayo, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine the aioli and set aside.
Wash, dry, and slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Place on a plate.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the tomato.
Slice eggs crosswise and add to the plate. Season tomato, avocado, and eggs with salt and pepper.
To assemble the sandwiches, spread muffin halves with aioli. Layer the bottom halves with avocado, tomato, and egg, then close with the top halves.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
